name: ModelVariant789_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant789_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (at six launch times a flare leaves a model point, rises along a sine arc and flies off with a fading, shrinking trail of sprites. When it lands it opens into a glow with two fans of rays, a textured ring and a pulsing sprite that grow and fade while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-806/903 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
